visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blue paper dragon model sits on a clean white flat surface. The camera pans from left to right, creating the illusion that the dragon's head is physically rotating to maintain eye contact. A cartoon avatar of a boy is visible in the upper-left corner. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) Three paper dragon models in blue, green, and red are lined up on a light-colored wooden tabletop. As the camera moves horizontally, all three dragon heads appear to pivot in perfect synchronization, following the camera's path. Small white text indicating a YouTube source is visible at the top. (3) A close-up shot of a red dragon model reveals the text 'GATHERING FOR GARDNER' on its base. The camera moves around the model, and the eyes seem to track the viewer's position. The background is a slightly blurry indoor setting. (4) The camera shifts to a steep side angle, revealing a green dragon model. From this perspective, it is clear that the dragon's head is actually a concave paper cutout that folds inwards. The illusion is broken as the camera shows the internal white side of the paper.
